main_text.l: Textoria, Nautica. Hæ artes vulgo dicuntur illiberales,
in sensu comparato. Neq; enim per se sunt indignæ libe-
rali ingenio: cum Christus fuerit faber lignarius, & qui-
dam ex apostolis piscatores, & Paulus artis textoriæ peri-
tus. Marc. 6. Matt. 4. Act. 18. De Bezaleele vide Exod. 31.
XII. Res homine indignæ sunt curiositatis
vel impietatis nomine infames. Eiusmodi sunt ma-
gia necromantica seu cacomagia, hydromantia, geoman-
tia, &c. de quibus Peucerus libro de divinationum generibus.
Insignis hac de re est locus Act. 19. versic. 19. Multi vero ex iis,

l.i: qui curiosa ista exercuerant, comportatos libros exusserunt in om-
nium conspectu: quorum supputatis pretijs, repererunt denariorum

main_text.l: quinquaginta millia. Quæ summa excrevit ad 32000. tha-
lerorum Philippicorum. Huc etiam refer falsò nomina-
tam scientiam, de quâ apostolus, 1. Tim. 6. versic. 20.
V. DIDACTICA SACRA.
I. Didactica sacra est quarta pars præcogni-
torum explicans methodum docendi &
discendi ex præscripto S. literarum. Ex Ter-
tulliano lib. de animâ licet appellare Discentiam. Eius finis
est, ut in hominis intellectu efficiatur facilior apprehen-
sio, & firmior impressio.
II. Didacticæ partes duæ sunt: una de devo-
tione, altera de intentione docentis & discentis.
III. Devotio est animi & corporis ad Deum
elevatio, consistens in precatione & sanctimo-
nia. Speculum huius devotionis lucidissimum est Salo-
mon 1. Reg. 3. à versic. 4. ad 16. & Sap. 9. Precatio debet esse
partim solennis & stata, partim varians. Precatio solennis
ordinarie concipi debet horis vere canonicis,
mane, me-ridie

page.notes: Marginal numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 are printed line markers in the left margin, transcribed as notes. The text is set in roman with italic for titles and citations. The line-end word "meridie" is split as "me-" / "ridie" and is written with its printed hyphen. The running head "DIDACTICA SACRA." is not a running head: it stands mid-page as a heading. Long s is written as s throughout. The reading "versic." for the abbreviation printed with a long s is a likely reading and is not marked. Printed 32000 is read as shown.
